snippet.title: Repterra Launches April 28 | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Repterra arrives April 28.

Wishlist & play the demo now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2768380/Repterra/

Watch the new teaser showcasing a major visual overhaul, with improved environments, lighting, and large-scale battles.

Build and defend your colony, manage resources, and take control of dinosaurs as allies in this survival RTS set in a world overrun by prehistoric predators.

Featuring massive battles, unique factions, and evolving heroes - prepare to reclaim Earth.
